name.description: Unique agent id, used with --agent. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (also the antigravity custom-agent id).

label.description: Display name shown in the menus

appId.description: GitHub App ID (numeric, stored as a string)

installationId.description: Optional override. Normally the installation id is resolved (repo owner, then the App's sole installation). Set this to pin a specific id or skip the lookup (offline, or in a git credential helper).

botName.description: GitHub App slug; the bot handle is <botName>[bot]

botId.description: Bot user id. Optional: auto-resolved from botName when omitted

privateKeyPath.description: Path to the App private key (.pem). ~ is expanded

systemPrompt.description: Identity / system prompt. Injected per process: claude --append-system-prompt, codex developer_instructions, antigravity a global custom agent selected with --agent

instructions.description: Fallback used as the prompt when systemPrompt is absent

identityPrompt.description: Fallback used as the prompt when systemPrompt and instructions are absent

repositories.description: Least-privilege: limit the installation token to these repo names

permissions.description: Least-privilege: complete allowlist of installation token permissions. GitHub grants ONLY these keys and drops the rest, even ones the App has. Reviewing PRs needs { "contents": "read", "pull_requests": "write" }. Omit this key to inherit the App's full grant.

providers.description: Per-provider overrides, keyed by provider value (e.g. { "claude": { "command": "claude" } })
